title: Create AoA Akamai setup
content:
Note: This page is mainly for Akamai Control Center Admins for AoA setup and IPEX DevOps team. That is registered in list of contacts https://akacdn.ingka.com/consumer-billing/. Only registered contact can view list after creating a akacdn-profile.

Note: Only authorized contacts are allowed to request certain type of support cases from Akamai, such as performing configuration changes; for example, adding a new root directory.

General support questions can otherwise be posted here: https://jira.digital.ingka.com/servicedesk/customer/portal/22/create/267

Note that it requires Auth0 (Authenticate via Auth0 ) to be able to file support requests.

Adding new Application

Adding a new application to AoA setup is a three step process.

  • Akamai Control Center admin create new AoA folder in Akamai NetStorage

  • Create personal Netstorage account for Architect / Development Lead, see section below

  • A request to update AoA property configuration to point to AoA folder

Create personal Netstorage

Give access to someone in team to Netstorage areas for product using ssh key. Ask person that should have access to create key with password using the command below and provide public key that is added to current storage account.

ssh-keygen -v -t rsa -b 2048 -C "Private key for {name}" -f {file name}

Create Upload account based on user alias e.g. johog6.
